name: NIST Incident Response Lifecycle
selection_reason: Ciclo de 4 fases: Preparation → Detection & Analysis → Containment, Eradication, Recovery → Post-Incident Activity.
template: NIST IR: Preparar → Detectar y Analizar → Contener, Erradicar, Recuperar → Post-Incidente.

name: SANS Incident Response Process
selection_reason: Proceso de 6 pasos: Preparation → Identification → Containment → Eradication → Recovery → Lessons Learned.
template: SANS IR: Preparar → Identificar → Contener → Erradicar → Recuperar → Lecciones Aprendidas.

name: PICERL Model
selection_reason: Modelo de 6 fases: Preparation → Identification → Containment → Eradication → Recovery → Lessons Learned.
template: PICERL: Preparar → Identificar → Contener → Erradicar → Recuperar → Aprender.

name: Incident Response Kill Chain
selection_reason: Adaptar el kill chain al contexto de respuesta: Detect → Analyze → Contain → Eradicate → Recover.
template: IR Kill Chain: Detectar → Analizar → Contener → Erradicar → Recuperar con métricas por fase.

name: Incident Triage Framework
selection_reason: Clasificación y priorización de incidentes por severidad e impacto.
template: Triage: Detectar → Clasificar (P1-P4) → Asignar → Escalar según severidad → Timeline de respuesta.

name: Digital Forensics Process
selection_reason: Proceso forense: Collection → Examination → Analysis → Reporting con cadena de custodia.
template: Forensics: Recolección (imaging) → Examinación (hash, timeline) → Análisis (correlación) → Reporte (evidencia legal).

name: Memory Forensics Methodology
selection_reason: Análisis de memoria volátil: RAM dump, process analysis, network connections, malware extraction.
template: Memory Forensics: Capture RAM → Extract processes → Analyze network connections → Find injected code → Extract malware artifacts.

name: Disk Forensics Methodology
selection_reason: Análisis de disco: imaging, file system analysis, deleted file recovery, timeline analysis.
template: Disk Forensics: Image disk → Mount read-only → Analyze file system → Recover deleted files → Create timeline → Correlate events.

name: Security Log Analysis Methodology
selection_reason: Análisis sistemático de logs: SIEM, auth logs, network logs, application logs.
template: Log Analysis: Collect logs → Normalize → Correlate → Detect anomalies → Investigate alerts → Create timeline → Report.

name: Incident Response Playbook
selection_reason: Playbooks específicos por tipo de incidente: malware, phishing, ransomware, data breach, DDoS.
template: IR Playbook: Definir triggers → Steps por fase → Roles y responsabilidades → Communication plan → Escalation path → Recovery steps.

name: Incident Communication Framework
selection_reason: Framework de comunicación durante incidentes: interna, externa, legal, prensa.
template: IR Comms: Internal stakeholders → Legal counsel → Regulatory notification → Customer notification → Media response → Board update.
